what: By-eye verdicts the lane's metrics are calibrated against. A window is a stretch of a source clip, with what is known of where the clip came from and on whose word it is used; a set is one shot of a window, judged by a named reader on named evidence. Per render: turn (does he end facing where the source faces), motion (does he move as the source moves) and look (is he still the person in the still). A field nobody judged is absent, never guessed.
